items.text: Xi Jinping is expected to ask Trump to stop arms sales to Taiwan during his visit to Washington. China considers Taiwan a source of instability in US-China relations. China also offered help to pressure Iran regarding the Middle East conflict.

The prices of some school supplies and living expenses have increased significantly. Welfare payments for some recipients have been cut without reason and there is no accountability. Additionally, the quality of gasoline has decreased, leading to higher vehicle repair costs.

The UK Prime Minister announced agreement to provide defensive support and aerial refueling to Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks. This action follows Saudi Arabia's request for military support. The UK will deploy a refueling aircraft to the region.

Emmanuel Macron announced that he met with Donald Trump in New York and agreed to cooperate to reduce tensions in energy markets. They emphasized protecting critical infrastructure in the Middle East and ensuring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. Macron also called for a halt to attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure and the start of peace negotiations.
Amanj Mohammadpour, a 33-year-old citizen from Bukan, was arrested by the Intelligence Department forces in Bukan on Sunday, September 29. He was transferred to an unknown location.

On Monday, 30 Shahrivar, a group of customs clearance agents and company owners held a protest at Khorramshahr customs. They demanded the removal of restrictions and prevention of monopoly in the car import market. They also requested equal conditions for economic activists.

The family of Mehrdad Ghorbani, a protester killed during the Mahsa uprising, commemorated the place where he was shot in Zanjan. Mehrdad Ghorbani, 18 years old, was directly shot by Islamic Republic forces on September 21, 2022. This video was released by Iran International.

The first day of speeches by world leaders at the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York is starting. This session is held amid the war between the US and Iran, the ongoing war in Ukraine, and escalating tensions in the Middle East.

Ticket sales for Lionel Messi's farewell match with the Argentina national team will start on September 22. Ticket prices range from 52 to 278 euros, and children can attend for 17 euros. The match will be held on October 6 against Benin.

A mother of a student stated that she paid two and a half million tomans for her daughter's school uniform. She described the uniform as resembling a sack and a cleric's cloak. It was also mentioned that five million tomans must be deposited into the school principal's account for her daughter to be allowed into the school.

The G7 foreign ministers have called on the Islamic Republic to stop sending weapons and military support to the Houthis in Yemen. The EU foreign policy chief stated that more than 10 warships are needed for the maritime mission in the Red Sea. These announcements were made ahead of the UN General Assembly meeting in New York.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the Islamic Republic can launch precision ballistic missiles thousands of kilometers away. He also said that Trump cannot impose his power on Iran. Ghalibaf emphasized that diplomacy is not surrender but the conversion of battlefield power into political achievements.
